consequence.statement: Application refresh requests made with a delay now set compareWith correctly; environments that hit the previous buggy behavior (issue #18998) will see the corrected refresh behavior.
consequence.remediation: No operator action required; after upgrading, verify that delayed application refreshes now set compareWith as expected.

assertion.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 fixes a bug so that compareWith is now set correctly when an application refresh is requested with delay (issue #18998).
